question:
**Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

The physics of laser-driven fusion is very __complex__.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Convoluted**" 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Complex **means having many intricate parts, difficult to understand, or involving a combination of elements. (जटिल)

 
 
• **For example**: *The instructions for assembling the furniture were quite complex, with many small pieces and steps.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Convoluted **means intricate, twisted, or complicated, often referring to something with many twists and turns or intricacies. (सवंलित)
 
 
• **For example**: *The convoluted plot of the movie left many audience members confused.*
 
 
 
• "Convoluted" is a synonym of "complex."
 
• It is an adjective that describes something that is difficult to understand or follow.

 Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Streamline**" means to simplify or make it more efficient. (सरल)
 
• "**Simplified**" means to make something easier to understand or do. (सरलीकृत)
 
• "**Modest**" means humble or not excessive. (आडंबरहीन)
